description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance of three different LLaMA-2 models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct prompting conditions: no SFT, + SFT on D₀, + SFT on D₀, D₁, and + SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂. The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, ranging from 0 to 80, while the horizontal axis lists the model variants. For each model, four bars are displayed, corresponding to the four prompting conditions, with a legend indicating the color and pattern for each. The results show that the performance generally increases with model size and the addition of SFT. For the LLaMA-2-7B model, the scores are approximately 67% (no SFT), 67% (+ SFT on D₀), 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 85% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). For the LLaMA-2-13B model, the scores are approximately 70% (no SFT), 75% (+ SFT on D₀), 85% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). For the LLaMA-2-70B model, the scores are approximately 80% (no SFT), 82% (+ SFT on D₀), 85% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 83% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). The chart indicates that while larger models generally achieve higher scores, the impact of SFT varies, with the most significant improvement observed for the LLaMA-2-7B model when SFT is applied on D₀, D₁, D₂.
